title: Install ARPE
show: The installer starts the board with a default demo. Load its printed address.

title: List projects and open the board
show: The installed command lists demo and prints the board address.

title: Create a project from a one-sentence mission
command: ${cli} new club-page "A public information page for our club"

waitFor.text: A public information page for our club

show: The new project appears alongside demo; no agent is needed.

title: Open the new project's board page

waitFor.text: Clarify the first measurable outcome with the owner

show: The starter Result, Purpose, running card and Check are ready for the owner.

title: Open the running card

waitFor.text: Clarify the first measurable outcome with the owner

show: Click the running card to inspect its details. The starter project has no decision yet.

title: Copy the countdown example

waitFor.text: Mission reviewed and first steps written down

show: The Guide's saved countdown example starts at zero of six cards. Its page and test are included.

title: Review the mission and validate the plan

waitFor.text: The mission and measurable plan are agreed

show: From the installed arpe-demo directory, review the mission; the structural check passes and one card is done.

title: Run the real browser Check

waitFor.text: The page passes all five browser checks

show: The five browser checks pass; the board records four done cards and a pending owner decision.

title: Open the owner-review card
show: Click the running owner-review card and inspect the screenshots attached to the decision.

title: Answer the decision on the board
show: Choose Looks right, keep it local and click Answer. No publication is attempted; the saved answer is verified.

title: Finish the local replay
show: The replay reads the actual saved answer, runs the browser Check again and records six completed cards.

title: Archive the completed Result

waitFor.text: Write one final case log entry

show: The final Check passes and the seventh card is done. The Result is archived in the project.
